prompt: Buatkan berita berdasarkan data kegiatan dalam dokumen ini untuk disampaikan kepada warga desa.
review_checklist: 40 volunteer participations (12 + 15 + 13), not 40 unique volunteers. Explicitly state unique volunteer attendance cannot be determined because people may join multiple sessions.
No invented waste categories, recycling results or environmental improvements.
expected_origin: Checked against supplied source data/text or visible poster. Human review required for semantic scoring.
